name: SIBUR-RT (the former TAIF holding)
via: SIBUR's own site lists its Tatarstan petrochemical stakes as held 'through SIBUR-RT (100%)'
note: TAIF JSC was acquired by SIBUR in the October 2021 merger (Kommersant, 2021-10-04) and renamed SIBUR-RT (АО «СИБУР-РТ»); it holds 64% of Kazanorgsintez and 83% of Nizhnekamskneftekhim.
